# <span id="aanchor22"></span> Run Duration Fix Utility

The Duration Fix utility addresses situations that cannot be fixed or addressed by normal data processing or editing in FLOWCAL, specifically gaps and overlaps in meter and source characteristics and analysis. The utility addresses issues in the revision zero records and the latest or current revision records.

Duration Fix is normally run under the suggestion of your Customer Support representative when an abnormal situation may point to possible gaps or overlaps in characteristic and analysis data. Running Duration Fix on a good data set is harmless and poses no risk to data integrity.

Duration Fix checks the continuity of characteristics and analysis for meters and sources and identifies gaps and overlaps for the following data:

- Meters
  - Characteristics
  - Analysis
- Quality Sources
  - Characteristics
  - Analysis
  - Extended Analysis

The utility will run for all of time to ensure that all gaps and overlaps are addressed.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Gaps">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Gaps</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Gaps">

Gaps are missing portions of data in characteristic or analysis records. They are fixed by moving the effective end date of the earlier record forward to meet the effective start date of the later record, removing the gap in data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 654;height: 219;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Overlaps">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Overlaps</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Overlaps">

Overlaps are when the effective end date of a previous record is greater than the effective start date of the next record.

Duration Fix addresses overlaps by moving the effective end date of the earlier record back to the effective start date of the next record. This creates a continuous record with no gaps or overlaps.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 654;height: 219;" />

</div>

<div class="procedure">

To run the Duration Fix utility:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **Toolbox**.
2.  Select a meter, meter list, location, close group, source, or source list.
3.  Select the **Run Duration Fix Utility** radio button.
4.  Click the **Run** button.

To run the Duration Fix standalone utility:

1.  Launch the utility from the FLOWCAL installation directory (e.g., **C:\\FLOWCAL install folder\]\Tools\DurationFix.exe**).
2.  When the login screen displays, enter your FLOWCAL username and password and click the **Login** button.
3.  When the utility screen displays, select a meter, meter list, location, close group, source, or source list and click **Run**. The utility will process each meter for all date time, as per the selected options, to log or fix gaps and overlaps.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

Selecting the "Log" option scans the data to identify and report gaps and overlaps; problems in the data are displayed on the utility screen and no fixes are performed.

</div>
